episode.title: Winter Song for Kids | Frozen Pond Rescue! | Thumpy Meadow
episode.description_intro: Join Dino and friends for four cozy Christmas adventures — a slippery pond, a heavy tree, a lost bell, and a runaway sled! Sing along and help the animals solve every snowy problem together with hugs and teamwork.
learning_points: Friends help each other when things go wrong
It is okay to ask for help
Winter is full of fun and cozy moments
Kindness makes everyone feel warm inside

es.title: ¡Rescate en el Estanque Helado! Canción de Animales Navideños | Thumpy Meadow
es.description: ¡Únete a Dino y sus amigos en cuatro aventuras navideñas llenas de nieve, abrazos y trabajo en equipo! Canta con el pato, la vaca, el cerdito y el pollito mientras resuelven juntos cada problema invernal.

pt.title: Resgate no Lago Gelado! Música de Animais de Natal | Thumpy Meadow
pt.description: Junte-se ao Dino e aos amigos em quatro aventuras natalinas cheias de neve, abraços e trabalho em equipe! Cante com o pato, a vaca, o porquinho e o pintinho enquanto resolvem cada problema juntos.

tr.title: Donmuş Gölde Kurtarma! Noel Hayvanları Şarkısı | Thumpy Meadow
tr.description: Dino ve arkadaşlarıyla dört sıcacık Noel macerasına katıl! Ördek, inek, domuz yavrusu ve civciv birlikte her kar problemini arkadaşlık ve yardımlaşmayla çözüyor.

id.title: Penyelamatan di Danau Beku! Lagu Hewan Natal | Thumpy Meadow
id.description: Bergabunglah bersama Dino dan teman-teman dalam empat petualangan Natal yang hangat! Bebek, sapi, anak babi, dan anak ayam menyelesaikan setiap masalah bersama dengan kerja sama dan pelukan.

stories.name: Duck Slips on the Ice!

hook.say: Oh! The pond is all frozen!

lines: Duck went out to see the big cold pond,
Duck kept sliding left and right so fast,
Chick called out to poor sliding Duck,
Duck grabbed on and held it very tight,
Duck stepped off the slippery cold ice,
Friends all hugged together by the pond,

ending.say: Thank you, friends! That was so fun!

stories.next: Hmm, what is making that big crunch?

stories.name: The Christmas Tree Is Too Heavy!

hook.say: Oh my! This tree is so heavy!

lines: On the farm there is a tree,
Cow wants it inside the barn now see,
With a push push here and a push push there,
Here a push, there a push, everywhere a push push,
But the tree won't budge at all,
Duck came over to the tree,
Flapping both its wings so cheerful and free,
With a quack quack here and a quack quack there,
Here a quack, there a quack, everywhere a quack quack,
Now they push the tree along,

talk.say: I will push with you, Cow!

lines: Dino marched up to the tree,
Helping all his friends so careful and free,
With a heave heave here and a heave heave there,
Here a heave, there a heave, everywhere a heave heave,
Now the tree is in the barn!
On the top they put a star,
Shining bright and near and very far,
With a glow glow here and a glow glow there,
Here a glow, there a glow, everywhere a glow glow,

stories.next: Oh? What is that sound under the snow?

stories.name: Cow's Bell Is Buried in Snow!

hook.say: My bell! Where is my bell?

lines: Cow has lost her little bell,
Cow has lost her small and little bell,
Chick went hopping through the snow,
through the snow, through the snow,
Chick went hopping all through the snow,
Dino thought of something very smart,
There the shiny bell was found,
bell was found, bell was found,
There the bright and shiny bell was found,
Now they dance on snowy hills,
Now they dance across the snowy hills,

ending.say: My bell is back! Thank you so much!

stories.next: Oh! Whose sled is going that way?

hook.say: Whoa! This is not my sled!

lines: Round and round the sled did spin,
Piglet laughed with a wide grin,
flapping wings from first to last,
Chick called out a cheerful peep,
over snow both wide and deep,
Chick reached out a fluffy wing,
caught the sled and stopped it so,
Now they share some candy sweet,
snowy treats are quite a treat,
All the friends held hands and spun,
winter play is so much fun!

ending.say: Best sled ride ever! Let us go again!

episode.goodbye: Bye bye, friends! See you next snowy time!
